name: diamond-v19
why: A Fusion 360 recreation held to the export's own numbers: a round brilliant as the intersection of its 57 facet half-spaces, standing in for the BoundaryFill that built it. Fusion measured 196778.06 mm3, 19789.2 mm2, 101.959 x 59.4 x 101.959 (its Y up), 57 planar faces; the recorded values below must keep agreeing with those, not merely with themselves.
